title: BenchmarkResult
description: A scored result within a run (BRES-####): either a single case (scope=case) or an aggregate over cases/repeats (scope=aggregate). Objective-first, evidence-linked, dual-confidence — the same discipline as the Evaluation Layer (ARCH-04; ADR-0015/0016/0017) applied to benchmarking (RFC-0026).

outcome_confidence.description: How good the work is (mirrors ARCH-04 outcome confidence).

judgment_confidence.description: How certain the scoring itself is. Objective-heavy results are high; model-assisted rubric items lower it (ADR-0017).

objective.description: Deterministic gate results (tests, coverage, retrieval precision/recall, latency budget, dependency rule, ...).

rubric_items.description: Qualitative, possibly model-assisted items — evidence required.

evidence.description: Linked evidence for the result (ADR-0016). Ties the score back to concrete ECL/MCG artifacts.

repeats.description: Number of repeated executions this result aggregates.

per_case.description: For scope=aggregate: the per-case result IDs rolled up here.

calibration.description: Confidence-calibration metrics (BENCH-10). Compares the Worker's stated confidence to observed correctness.

cost.description: Reasoning cost accounting (BENCH-13). Provider-neutral where possible.

gaming_flags.description: Anti-gaming detections tripped while scoring (ARCH-04). Non-empty flags cap or void the score.
